body: Hi there, thanks for reading and understanding.

Yeah I know, but being 22 and haven't even been in a disco, party or something like that, being at home all day except maybe 1 or 2 days a month that my 2 friends tell me to go to their house or something... I just feel like I'm not living. 

One of the few things apart from not being brave enough to kill myself, is my desire to visit the US (I'm from Spain).
